{{Quote|An Ubrikkian 9,000? That's no junk. Even as parts, it's more than the pot. Miners are clamoring for them.|Ria Clarr, to Cikatro Vizago|<ref name="Rebel Bluff">{{InsiderCite|158|Rebel Bluff}}</ref>}}
The '''9000 Z001 landspeeder''',<ref name="YouTube" /> also known as the '''Ubrikkian 9,000''', and colloquially referred to as the '''Ubrik''', was a [[landspeeder]] model of an unusual rounded pod design.

A few [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]], 9000 Z001 landspeeder's were sought after by [[Mining|miners]], and could be sold to a high [[Currency|price]] even as spare parts. [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], who owned a farmland on [[Lothal]], purchased an 9000 Z001- landspeeder for scouting potential mining sites on his property. During a game of [[sabacc]] with [[Ria Clarr]], [[Cikatro Vizago]], and [[Jho]], Calrissian added the keycard of that landspeeder to the [[sabacc pot]].<ref name="Rebel Bluff" />

[[File:Anzellan-Mechanic.png|left|250px|thumb|Anzellan Mechanics using one of these landspeeders within the Grand Arena.]]
One 9000 Z001 landspeeder was parked outside [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]'s entrance during a scuffle between a [[Sullustan]] and [[Rodian]] [[Greedo]].<ref name="SW 28">[[Star Wars (2015) 28|''Star Wars'' (2015) 28]]</ref> A 9000 Z001 landspeeder was also at the exact same location during [[Luke Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO]]'s venture to hire a [[starship]] from the [[spaceport]] [[Mos Eisley]]<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> in [[1 BBY]].<ref name="ANH Date">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref>

By [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{HuntersDate}}</ref> a trio of [[Unidentified Anzellan mechanics|Anzellan Mechanics]] utilized one of these landspeeders while hosting the [[Hunters of the Outer Rim]] [[Scrap Salvage]] event within the [[Grand Arena]] on the [[planet]] [[Vespaara]], allowing [[Hunter (Grand Arena)|Hunters]] to deposit scrap inside of it to score points.<ref name="Hunters">''[[Star Wars: Hunters]]''</ref>
